description: This file defines the PayGradeService class, which provides business logic and data access functionalities related to pay grades and associated currencies within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting pay grade data, as well as managing related currencies and pay periods.

classes.name: PayGradeService
classes.description: Provides business logic for managing pay grades and associated currencies, including retrieval, validation, creation, update, and deletion operations within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: getPayGradeDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the PayGradeDao instance used for data access operations.

methods.name: setPayGradeDao
methods.description: Sets the PayGradeDao instance, primarily for dependency injection or testing purposes.

methods.name: getPayGradeById
methods.description: Retrieves a PayGrade entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getPayGradeList
methods.description: Returns a list of PayGrade entities based on optional filtering parameters.

methods.name: getCurrencyListByPayGradeId
methods.description: Fetches list of currencies linked to a specific pay grade.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of PayGradeCurrency entities based on provided search filters.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyListCount
methods.description: Gets count of the pay grade currencies matching search filters.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCurrencyIdAndPayGradeId
methods.description: Fetches a PayGradeCurrency by currency ID and pay grade ID.

methods.name: isValidSalaryAmountForPayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Validates whether a given salary amount falls within the min/max bounds for a specific pay grade and currency.

methods.name: getPayPeriodArray
methods.description: Returns an array of pay period models normalized for external use.

methods.name: getPayGradeArray
methods.description: Returns an array of pay grade models normalized for external use.

methods.name: getCurrencyArray
methods.description: Returns an array of currency models normalized for external use.

methods.name: getCurrencyById
methods.description: Fetches a CurrencyType entity by its ID.

methods.name: savePayGrade
methods.description: Saves a PayGrade entity to the database.

methods.name: deletePayGrades
methods.description: Deletes multiple pay grades given their IDs.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrencies
methods.description: Retrieves allowed pay currencies based on search filters.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrenciesCount
methods.description: Counts allowed pay currencies based on search filters.

methods.name: deletePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Deletes currencies associated with a pay grade.
